name: The Adversary
description: Someone who makes a power grab in New Capenna.

description_citations.text: "Streets of New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jinnie and Jetmir plan the Crescendo and discuss the Adversary and the Font.
timeline.quote: "Besides, the moment the Font is revealed, everything in New Capenna will change and the Cabaretti will be on top."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Xander tells Elspeth about the Adversary and the Cabaretti's Font, and orders her to infiltrate the Cabaretti and leave a door unlocked.
timeline.quote: tell me where the Font is kept and leave a door unlocked.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien meets her Obscura contact Navy in the Mezzio, trading information about the Font and the Adversary's lounge while hiding what she knows.
timeline.quote: "Not yet, but I'll find out," Vivien lied.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien goes to the Adversary's lounge hoping Elspeth will arrive as a Maestro, refuses to drink Halo, and sneaks some into a vial.
timeline.quote: Vivien could sneak some of the Halo out of the lounge and back to Urabrask without arousing suspicion.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien hears a deep, vaguely familiar chuckle from a hidden room revealed in the lounge.
timeline.quote: She heard a deep chuckle echo from the back somewhere.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Navy ambushes Vivien outside the lounge with a dagger, saying the boss does not like people sniffing near his doorstep.
timeline.quote: "And the boss doesn't like people sniffing this close to his doorstep."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien resolves to be at the Crescendo where Elspeth will likely be, and learns from Urabrask that the Adversary is a demon planeswalker.
timeline.quote: "Tezzeret mentioned he is a planeswalker, too."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: As the Adversary's influence grows, conflicts between the families escalate.
timeline.quote: As the Adversary's influence grew, the conflicts between families escalated.

citation.text: Make an Example (New Capenna Commander, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: As the Adversary's forces descend on the gala, Elspeth offers to get Giada out.
timeline.quote: As the Adversary's forces descended upon the gala, Elspeth whispered to Giada, "I can get you out of here, but we have to go now."

citation.text: Daring Escape (Streets of New Capenna, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The fragile alliances between the crime families strain toward breaking as halo runs out and the Adversary makes a power grab.
timeline.quote: The fragile alliances that foster peace between the families are being strained to a breaking point as the precious commodity halo seems to be running out

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Crescendo Elspeth rescues Giada from agents of the Adversary.
timeline.quote: she was rescued from agents of the Adversary by Elspeth Tirel

citation.text: "Giada", section "New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Adversary hoards Halo to monopolize it while the Cabaretti keep it flowing with a new supply unveiled at Crescendo.
timeline.quote: the Cabaretti have kept the Halo flowing through a new supply

citation.text: "Halo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Crescendo celebration, Jetmir is gravely wounded by agents of the Adversary and tended to by his adopted daughter in an Obscura safehouse.
timeline.quote: Jetmir was gravely wounded by agents of the Adversary

citation.text: "Jetmir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Siding with the Adversary, Kamiz was wounded by Jinnie Fay after an ambush.
timeline.quote: she was wounded by Jinnie Fay after attempting an ambush following the Crescendo attack

citation.text: "Kamiz", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Revealed as a double agent working for the boss.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

relations.quote: Siding with the Adversary in his revolt against the families
